stem: A single drainage sample has much higher EC than the input solution. What is the strongest interpretation before changing irrigation or fertilizer settings?
choices: Treat the crop as overfed and reduce fertilizer concentration before collecting any additional drainage or moisture data
Treat the substrate as excessively dry and increase irrigation frequency before comparing the result with other samples
Treat the input solution as incorrectly mixed and replace the tank before repeating the drainage measurement
Verify sampling and compare input EC, root-zone moisture, drainage behavior, and trends before assigning a cause
rationale: A single drainage EC result is not enough to identify cause. Interpretation should combine a verified sample with input conditions, root-zone water status, drainage behavior, and trend data before management changes are made.
